item.title: JavaScript: Calculate ISO Week Number
item.description:
“JavaScript: Calculate ISO Week Number”

Calculating the ISO 8601 week number can be surprisingly complex due to the standard’s specific rules, which differ from simpler week-counting methods. The ISO 8601 standard defines week 1 of a year as the first week that contains a Thursday. Weeks always begin on Monday and end on Sunday. Dates near the start or end of the year can belong to a week of the previous or next year, respectively.

item.title: How to Accurately Calculate Workdays Between Two Dates in SQL Server
item.description:
When working with date ranges in SQL Server, one common task is calculating the number of workdays (business days) between two dates. This is particularly important in applications that require deadlines, business date tracking, and schedule planning. Let’s dive into the best methods for calculating workdays in SQL Server using T-SQL, ensuring we exclude weekends and can optionally account for holidays.

Simple Workday Calculation in SQL Server

To begin, let’s establish the basic structure to calculate workdays between two dates, focusing on Monday through Friday as workdays.
